newsitem.title: USA: Teco's rate pact approved by regulators.
newsitem.headline: Teco's rate pact approved by regulators.

text.p: Tampa Electric Co said Wednesday the Florida Public Service Commission had approved the utility's agreement with the Florida Office of Public Counsel and the Florida Industrial Power Users Group.
The agreement, announced on September 25, resolves all pending regulatory issues associated with the company's new Polk Power Station, TECO Energy Inc subsidiary said.

It provides for full recovery of all of the expected capital costs and all operation and maintenance expenses associated with the Polk Power Station, the first commercial use of combined cycle technology with coal gasification.

The agreement extends through 1999 the base rate freeze currently in effect. Its revenue sharing arrangements provide the company an opportunity to earn up to a 12.75 percent return on equity, Tampa Electric noted.
